subject: Show a conditionalPanel only wgen a file has been selected

messages.author: cf3aa7d5d2624064
messages.subject: Show a conditionalPanel only wgen a file has been selected
parts:
Good evening,

This is probably a newbie question, I started shiny yesterday :-)

I'm trying to show elements of the UI only when a file has been loaded (let's say I want to display the name of the file, for instance).

I have the following working code:


ui.R

# skip a few...
sidebarPanel(
fileInput("infile",label="
Select a file"
                ),
textOutput("outfile")
)

server.R
# etc. 
output$outfile<-renderPrint({input$infile})

Ok. So when no file is selected I get NULL, and when a file is selected I get a (poorly formatted, but that's not the point :-) ) text giving info on the file.

Now, I want this information to be displayed only when a file is selected, and nothing when no file is loaded (of course, the real app will be putting more in the panel than just info on the file). So I tried

ui.R

# skip a few...
fileInput("infile",label="Select a file"
                ),
conditionalPanel(
         condition="input.infile!=null",
         textOutput("outfile")
)

.. and the text is never displayed, whether a file is loaded or not. From which I would tend to think that thefile is always null (in js), even when a file is loaded?

So the question is, how should I write my condition to get the conditionalPanel displayed when a file is loaded ?

Thanks !

JF
